scope.included: The 25 separately measured, named GSE254315 donors only.
scope.external_atlas_donors: Donor1-3, Donor26-29, and Donor31-33 are reused external atlas samples, not additional GSE254315 libraries; they are excluded from this step.

mandatory_caveat: Changing germ-cell-stage composition can mimic broad expression displacement without cell-intrinsic aging drift. Testis hits or nulls cannot support general whole-body aging claims.

mapping.primary_age_source: Current primary Fig. 1a source data, whose row order is Donor1 through Donor35 and agrees with GEO for 24 of 25 GSE donors.
mapping.donor8_discrepancy: Primary Fig. 1a says 40 years/40s; GEO GSM8037622 says 39 years. Primary analyses use 40/40s and a complete GEO-39 sensitivity changes both exact age and decade.
mapping.released_cell_annotations: No public barcode-to-cell-type annotation or annotated expression object was found in GEO, primary supplements, or the released code repository. Aggregate age-level cell totals are not a per-donor barcode crosswalk.
mapping.consequence: P1, cell-type pseudobulk, CLR, and Hellinger are blocked pending a released donor-and-barcode annotation crosswalk. Raw-count QC and released descriptive metadata are permitted; no whole-testis expression model will substitute for comparable cell types or germ-cell stages.

primary.name: ordinal_decade_depth
primary.design: All 25 donors; ordinal scores 3, 4, 5, 6 for primary-source 30s, 40s, 50s, 60s; effect per one-decade increase with donor mean natural-log actual raw UMI adjustment.
primary.young_middle_old: No group is discarded. The 30s are the young reference for Hellinger, 40s are middle, and 50s/60s are older decades in the ordered trend.

sensitivities.name: ordinal_decade_unadjusted
sensitivities.design: Primary ordinal decade without depth or other covariates.

sensitivities.name: ordinal_decade_bmi_depth
sensitivities.design: Primary ordinal decade plus depth and primary-source continuous BMI; no BMI categories or interaction.

sensitivities.name: categorical_decade_depth
sensitivities.design: Depth-adjusted indicators for 40s, 50s, and 60s with 30s as reference; all 25 donors.

sensitivities.name: old_young_depth
sensitivities.design: Old 50s/60s versus young 30s, depth-adjusted; middle 40s excluded only from this contrast.

sensitivities.name: exact_age_depth
sensitivities.design: Primary-source exact age per 10 years plus depth, all 25 donors; no midpoint imputation.

sensitivities.name: geo_donor8_39
sensitivities.design: Repeat ordinal_decade_depth, categorical_decade_depth, old_young_depth, and exact_age_depth after changing only Donor8 from 40/40s to 39/30s.

sensitivities.name: spermatogenesis_adjusted
sensitivities.design: If a released donor-linked incomplete-spermatogenesis field exists, repeat ordinal_decade_depth with that field; otherwise record not released. Do not infer the field from expression or germ-cell fractions.

sensitivities.name: complete_spermatogenesis_only
sensitivities.design: If and only if a released donor-linked incomplete-spermatogenesis field exists, repeat ordinal_decade_depth among complete-spermatogenesis donors; otherwise untestable.

contrasts_if_annotations_become_availabl.model_gate: Full rank, at least six donors overall, at least three donors in every retained group, and at least two residual degrees of freedom. All-male cohort: no sex covariate. Failed fits are untestable, not null.

annotation_and_eligibility.composition_universe: All released known labels for a donor, retaining zeros after a label passes the cell-type eligibility gate; somatic and germ-cell-stage analyses remain separate.
annotation_and_eligibility.current_status: Every cell-resolved endpoint and label is blocked before eligibility because the required annotation crosswalk is not public.

P1_transport.normalization: Per-cell log1p(CPM) using actual full-feature raw library size; arithmetic donor mean within released cell label; up mean minus down mean. Ambiguous duplicate gene symbols are excluded from P1.
P1_transport.detection_gate: At least one uniquely mapped detected P1 up gene and one down gene per donor/cell-type analysis.
P1_transport.matched_null: Primary ordinal model only: 200 draws, seed 20261114; donor-mean logCPM expression deciles per cell type, up/down matched separately, all detected P1 genes excluded, sampling without replacement, one RNG stream over sorted cell types. Centered two-sided empirical p=(1+exceedances)/201.
P1_transport.models: Primary plus every declared applicable sensitivity; no cell-level tests.

donor_pseudobulk.aggregation: Sum raw counts within donor and released cell label; log2CPM=log2((count+0.5)/(total+1)*1e6). Never sum donors before modeling.
donor_pseudobulk.gene_filter: At least 10 summed counts and detection in at least 20 percent of eligible donors, fixed without age outcomes.
donor_pseudobulk.models: Ordinal primary and all declared applicable sensitivities with donor-level OLS effect, standard error, two-sided t 95 percent CI and p-value.
donor_pseudobulk.scope: Somatic labels and each comparable germ-cell stage separately; no mixed germ-stage pseudobulk primary endpoint.

CLR_composition.transform: Add 0.5 cell to each released known label per donor, normalize within donor, centered log-ratio.
CLR_composition.models: Ordinal primary and all declared applicable sensitivities; raw fractions descriptive only.
CLR_composition.scope: Report somatic labels and germ-cell stages separately and preserve the germ-stage confounding caveat.

Hellinger.technical_exclusions: MT-/RPL/RPS/MRPL/MRPS prefixes and XIST, TSIX, DDX3Y, EIF2S3Y, UTY, KDM5D.
Hellinger.cell_filter: Actual raw UMI >=1500 and positive nontechnical UMI.
Hellinger.reference: Primary-source 30s young donors only within cell type; pool reference counts and subtract the evaluated young donor's own counts (cross-fitting).
Hellinger.endpoint: Arithmetic donor mean per-cell Hellinger distance, no UMI downsampling.
Hellinger.floors: At least two young reference donors, 20 qualifying cells per scored donor, 50 cross-fitted reference cells for every donor, six scored donors, and model rank/df gates.
Hellinger.models: Depth-adjusted primary and declared applicable sensitivities; unadjusted as sensitivity only.
Hellinger.scope: Each comparable somatic label and germ-cell stage separately.

multiplicity_families_if_unblocked.P1_CLR_Hellinger: BH at 0.05 over eligible cell types separately by endpoint, design, and model. Somatic and germ-stage results remain labeled and are never pooled into a whole-body claim.
multiplicity_families_if_unblocked.P1_matched_null: BH at 0.05 over primary eligible cell types, separate from conventional P1 model p-values.
multiplicity_families_if_unblocked.pseudobulk: BH at 0.05 over tested genes separately by design, model, and released cell type.
multiplicity_families_if_unblocked.untestable: Excluded from BH denominator but retained in output with the failed annotation/floor/rank reason.

descriptive_qc_while_blocked.allowed: Per-donor raw barcode count, finite nonnegative integer validation, UMI and detected-feature summaries, mitochondrial fraction, and counts passing the paper's released QC thresholds.
descriptive_qc_while_blocked.paper_qc_thresholds: 200-5500 detected features, 800-17000 UMI, mitochondrial fraction <=25 percent.
descriptive_qc_while_blocked.not_allowed: Age-associated QC modeling, expression signatures, pseudobulk outcomes, composition reconstruction, marker-based labels, or cell-level p-values.

resources.guard: scripts/resource_guard.py for every download and expression-QC job
resources.order: GSM8037606 through GSM8037630; matrix, barcodes, features per donor, then one-donor-at-a-time QC.
